searchData.summary: Find genes containing a specified protein domain from the InterPro database. The InterPro family of databases includes CATH, CCD, HAMAP, PANTHER, Pfam, PIRSF, PRINTS, PRODOM, PROFILE, PROSITE, SFLD, SMART, SUPERFAMILY, TIGRFAMs.

dynamicAttributes.help: The *search result weight*. This is the sum of the weights you specified for individual searches that found this record.   The more searches that found this record the higher will be its weight.  To give a search a weight, click "Use Weights" on the search page, and provide the desired weight.

searchData.description:
Find genes whose predicted protein contains a domain from the InterPro set of domain databases.

First choose the Organism(s) and Domain Database that you wish to query.

Then use either the 'Domain' or the 'Domain wildcard search' parameter to indicate the protein domain you wish to find.

When using the 'Specific Domain (s)' parameter, begin typing a domain name, accession or description, to see a list of all possible domains that match what you have typed. Then choose a domain name from the list. You can choose multiple domains using CTRL- or CMD-click when choosing the domains.

When using the 'Free Text (use'*' for wildcard)' parameter, type the text term you wish to find, including an asterisk wildcard for ambiguous portions of your text term. (*ase, kin*, *kinase*) The search will query for all domains whose names, accessions or descriptions contain your text.

The domain matches to protein sequence are determined using the InterProScan program. To learn more about InterPro see the InterPro tutorial.

Domain Databases
InterPro Database (includes Pfam Database)
PRINTS Database
ProDom Database
PROSITE Database
SMART Database
SUPERFAMILY Database
TIGRFAMS Database

Selecting a large number of organisms may impact performance and make results harder to interpret.

Please select five or fewer organisms where possible.

parameters.help:
Use this parameter to indicate the domain you wish to query for. Genes returned by this search have protein products that are predicted to contain the domain(s) you indicate here.

Begin typing a domain name, accession or description, to see a list of all possible domains that match what you have typed. Then choose a domain name from the list. You can choose multiple domains using CTRL- or CMD-click when choosing the domains.

Or paste a list of domain IDs separated by a comma, new line, white space or semicolon.
